title: ENABLE TRIGGER
description: Learn how to re-enable disabled triggers using the ENABLE TRIGGER statement.

data.text: The ENABLE TRIGGER statement allows you to re-enable a disabled trigger so that it can fire again when associated events occur.

data.title: Enable a single trigger
data.content: Re-enables a specific DML trigger on a table.
data.code:
ENABLE TRIGGER [schema_name.][trigger_name]
ON [object_name | DATABASE | ALL SERVER]

data.title: Enable all triggers on a table
data.content: Re-enables all triggers on the specified table.

data.title: Enable all triggers on a database
data.content: Re-enables all triggers in the current database.

data.title: ENABLE TRIGGER Key Points
points: Use ENABLE TRIGGER to re-enable a previously disabled trigger.
You can enable a single trigger, all triggers on a table, or all triggers on a database.
Enabling a trigger restores its functionality immediately.
Triggers are disabled for troubleshooting or bulk data operations.
